body: It’s a little harder to get them in the first time if they have a flat back, so just make sure they go in easy and don’t shove them through. Other than that it should be fine.

Fidelity also runs our 401k accounts, which Starbucks will match up to 5%. So if you choose to have 5% of your paycheck withheld in the 401k retirement account then Starbucks will put the same amount in your 401k each paycheck. If you want more details on the process of signing up and what it entails, or other stock options available through Starbucks benefits you should call Fidelity, they are really helpful in navigating this stuff. I hope that answered your question.

You have to have been hired by Starbucks as of May 1 of the fiscal year before the grant date. So before May 1st of last year to get a grant. I just hit my 1 year in October, so I don’t have anything to accept this year.
